campaign: LEXIGEN v5 Causal Transfer Generalization Experiment

instantiation_policy.uniform_assignment_exact: Used when a frozen proposal contains reduced_representation or native_backend_substitution. For equal uniform square marginals, reduce the transport LP to linear assignment and construct the exact permutation transport plan; otherwise fall back to the reference POT solver.
instantiation_policy.pot_reference_exact: Conservative exact fallback for proposals whose structural preconditions are absent or not safely expressible from source semantics.

learned_recipe_interpretation.TM-PBEB-01: native scipy assignment backend when the exact uniform reduction applies
learned_recipe_interpretation.TM-CAC-01: reference fallback; no separately certified active core identified before official data

causal_equivalence_rule: Any no-transfer/random/static candidate using uniform_assignment_exact is implementation-equivalent to a learned candidate using the same mechanism and blocks causal credit.
